proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  classical
  intro N inst c
  have hdegree (s : Finset (ZMod N)) : (M7.Supports.polynomial s).natDegree ≤ N := by
    by_cases hz : M7.Supports.polynomial s = 0
    · simp [hz]
    · have hi := Polynomial.natDegree_mem_support_of_nonzero hz
      rw [M7.Supports.support] at hi
      obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
      rw [← he]
      exact Nat.le_of_lt (ZMod.val_lt i)
  have ha := hdegree c.1
  have hb := hdegree c.2
  have hm : (M6.Cyclic.modulus N).natDegree ≤ N := by
    unfold M6.Cyclic.modulus
    exact le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _) (by simp)
  dsimp [M8.Solver.originalF, M8.PhysicalBridge.signature, M7.RecipeSignature.signature]
  solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 8) [M6.Euclid.preprocess_correct_cost, And.left, And.right]
